title: Final Energy Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final energy required to excite the electron to the first excited state is correctly calculated as 3.8 eV.

title: Use of Virial Theorem
description: Important Criteria: The application of the virial theorem to relate kinetic and potential energy is correctly stated and utilized.

title: Correct Expression for Omega
description: Important Criteria: The expression for angular frequency omega is derived correctly from the ground state energy relation.

title: Substitution of Values
description: Important Criteria: The correct values for h-bar, electron mass, and the position variance are substituted accurately into the energy equation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units throughout the calculations are consistent and correctly handled.

title: Common Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the calculations that could lead to an incorrect final answer.

title: Limiting Cases Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: Consideration of limiting cases or alternative methods to verify the result is discussed.
